activity_summary: At dinner you stayed at the lodging while Titus went on at the Cross Keys. You were not in it. The loaf was a penny loaf a finger short, and no second was bought. The board was threepence. Mistress Ansell would not be sent to the Bell. You left the carrier for tomorrow.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed, and left the carrier for tomorrow.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the table and refused the errand.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the finger and bought nothing.

entities.name: Titus Andronicus

facets.activity: Ate at home while Titus went on

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I can hear none of it, which is what a wall is for.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not in it today. The desk has me.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Threepence, whether you make a speech of it or not.
